verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a business-formation and back-office service covering incorporation, registered agent, banking access, accounting, tax and mailroom. Configurable signer identity verification (SMS, ID check, knowledge-based) on sensitive documents is an e-signature platform capability, so this story is outside Firstbase's product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Firstbase ships an e-signature workflow that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can require stronger signer identity verification (SMS, ID check, knowledge-based) on sensitive documents
